'''Joh Steen''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Red Star Shipping Lines]] vessel designated [[Transport A-175]]. When Steen encountered a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] en route from the [[Nopces system/Legends|Nopces system]] to join a convoy at the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]], he cooperated fully with the instructions given to him by this apparently legitimate [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] vessel. In fact, the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Privateer/Legends|Privateer]] vessel ''[[Far Orbit]]'', and Steen's misplaced trust resulted in the loss of his cargo of power cells and power system components worth approximately 35 million credits.<ref name="HS" />
